changelog.message: op created for native Node N-API-backed Apple Speech-to-Text engine
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Transcribes default or custom microphone audio input to a text string in real-time using native macOS Apple Speech APIs directly in memory.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global microphone listening and speech transcription.

ports.name: Language Locale
ports.text: Select from the list of supported locales (e.g. en-US, es-ES, fr-FR) for transcription.

ports.name: Audio Input Device
ports.text: Select from the list of dynamically discovered physical/virtual audio input devices on your macOS system.

ports.name: Output Mode
ports.text: Choose how transcribed text is outputted: Full Transcript (entire accumulated sentence), New Words Only, or Chunk.

ports.name: Silence Duration (s)
ports.text: Silence duration (in seconds) to wait before flushing the current transcription context block.

ports.name: Reset Text
ports.text: Fires a trigger to clear/reset the transcribed text buffer output.

ports.name: Transcribed Text
ports.text: Output containing the real-time transcribed text feed.

ports.name: On Word Received
ports.text: Fires a trigger when a new transcription word or segment update is received.

ports.name: Is Final Segment
ports.text: True if the current transcribed text represents a finalized sentence block segment.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native speech tracking engine is active.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the tracking engine.
